Kumari Shipra

Technical Program Manager | Agile Delivery Manager

Gurugram, Haryana, India

Email: dipra010692@gmail.com

Phone: +91 9903807426

LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/shipra-kumari59b215b9

Impact-Driven Strategic Project & Agile Leader with 9 years of cross-functional experience driving AI-led Digital Transformation, Automation & Platform Innovation for Fortune 500 & Consulting firms across Financial Services, FinTech & Banking. Proven ability to lead high-impact Projects, cost savings, and accelerate Time-To-Market (TTM) by 80% with strong expertise in GenAI, Project Strategy, Roadmap Development, Go-To-Market (GTM) Execution, Agile (Scrum, Kanban) and Stakeholder Leadership. Passionate about building scalable, data-driven & user-centric Projects that fuel exponential business impact. Recognized for exceptional ability to lead cross-functional teams, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment that drives project success and accountability.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Project Manager

PWC Oct’24 – Feb’25

Demonstrated strong leadership skills by successfully guiding diverse teams at Adobe and Microsoft. Throughout my tenure, I've overseen the entire project lifecycle, from formulating business cases to project initiation, planning, and execution. My commitment to ongoing enhancement prompted me to closely monitor essential metrics such as KPIs, compliance, and risk factors. I prioritized transparent communication by consistently providing stakeholders with weekly updates on project progress and developments.

Monitoring and reporting on project progress, identifying potential challenges, and proactively implementing solutions to keep projects on track and

aligned with business goals.

Overseeing multiple programs, aligning them with corporate strategy through project goal setting and charter development.



Coordinating the project portfolio to support strategic aims by defining project parameters and deliverables.

• Managing end-to-end project lifecycles, from planning and resource allocation to execution and post-implementation reviews, ensuring timely delivery and achievement of key milestones.

Leading cross-functional projects across multiple business verticals, driving initiatives, and ensuring alignment with corporate objectives.

Developing and implementing project management frameworks and best practices to optimize efficiency, mitigate risks, and enhance overall program

performance.

•

Facilitating seamless communication and coordination between various departments, fostering collaboration, and driving successful project outcomes Leading automation initiatives and supervising full-cycle delivery of technical solutions via timeline planning, resource coordination, budget oversight, and milestone monitoring.



Tracking and addressing project challenges using risk documentation, escalating urgent impediments to ensure on-schedule delivery.

Managing project uncertainties and issues via structured risk tools, promptly informing stakeholders of critical concerns for timely completion.

Manager Dec '20 - Jun'24

HSBC

1. End-to-End Discovery & Transition Ownership: Led the discovery and transition phases, aligning cross-functional teams across ASP Canada and MENAT

Regions, ensuring documentation, process clarity, and operational readiness.

2. Operational Optimization: Identified inefficiencies, designed mitigation strategies, and oversaw smooth transition into production-ready processes.

3.

Stakeholder Engagement: Facilitated collaboration and alignment, validated workflows, and ensured adoption readiness.

4. Process and Resource Planning: Allocate resources effectively for multistream bank programs, optimize effort estimation for regulatory & IT projects

5. Continuous Improvement: Post transition oversight to drive process excellence, monitor KPIs, and implement feedback loops for operational efficienc

y

6. Ensure adherence to regulatory standards and internal controls for audit readiness .

Led daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospective meetings, actively pinpointing and resolving challenges.

Upgraded Developer Projectivity with 80% faster Bug Resolutions by introducing a Log Monitoring Framework that enables real-time system performance

tracking

Created Leadership Reports & Dashboards to monitor Project Portfolios, enabling Data-Driven Decision Making & aligning Organizational Strategy.

Organized Scrum ceremonies, reviewed High Level System Design (HLD), conducted code reviews, and tracked project status to ensure alignment with

business goals and timely delivery.

Mentored & coached 13 junior team members through on-job training, personal development, and performance management, while actively participating in recruitment efforts to build a strong Agile team, fostering a high-performance culture.

Closely worked with Top business stakeholders to migrate the regulatory report and BAU Reports

Conducted regular retrospective to gain insights and worked on data migration for different markets ( ASP, MENAT, UK and Europe)

Assistant Manager

HSBC Aug '17 - Dec '20 •

Prepared governance reports and materials including steering committee packs , dashboards , governance materials and monthly reports in forums .



Authored PRDs, BRDs, and stakeholder pitch presentations to align Project vision, secure buy-in, and drive execution for multiple client projects.



Optimized backlog management and sprint execution by facilitating Scrum ceremonies, refining KPIs, and aligning OKRs, ensuring faster Project iterations and data-driven decision-making.



Facilitated development of Generative AI Agent (Chatbot) 'DUGBot' for Export Controls that accurately detected 99.6% of High-Risk transactions in

Trade Finance through Prompt Engineering techniques, enhancing AML / CTF controls and strengthening HSBC's Regulatory Compliance. • Applied

Agile Methodology in building a strategic Roadmap for 'DUGBot', optimizing Project Backlog Refinements & managing User



Stories resulting in 15% faster sprint completions. Orchestrated agile sprints to consolidate million data points from diverse structured and unstructured client systems, leveraging SQL to generate actionable business insights.



Lead end to end delivery of compliance and regulatory initiatives across KYC, Customer Onboarding , CDD and EDD programs .



Directed the creation of a Tableau dashboard for real-time process monitoring and quality assurance, enabling proactive decision making and operational efficiency.

Associate May '15 - Jul '17 WIPRO



Drove digital transformation for USA-based External Client & UK-based External Client by leading cross-functional teams in data-driven decision making, backlog prioritization, and Agile execution, ensuring seamless project delivery.



Optimized sprint execution by strategic JIRA Backlog Management for a team of 5 Data Engineers, reducing Project backlogs by 85% weekly and enhancing development efficiency.



Revamped due diligence operations by 90% by designing system architectures (HLD & LLD)



Built an NLP-powered Pattern Matching Algorithm to classify Banking Merchant payments and enhance Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Models, strengthening fraud detection capabilities.



Gained 60% operational efficiency by automating Account Receivable (A/R) Reconciliations for USA-based External Client



Spearheaded recruitment efforts by interviewing & assessing candidates for Python, SQL & Data Structures, strengthening Data Analytics team.

EDUCATION B.Tech - Computer Science Engineering May ‘15 JNTU, Kakinada Vizag, India

KEY SKILLS



Data-Driven Decision Making – Thought Leadership, Data Analytics, KPI & OKR Definition, Business Intelligence (BI), Financial Insights, Risk & Compliance Analytics.



Process Automation & Optimization – Digital Transformation, Workflow Automation, Process Re-Engineering, Cost Reduction Strategies,



User Experience (UX) & Design Thinking Principles – Wireframing, Rapid Prototyping, Customer Journey Mapping, UX Research, A/B Testing



Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Leadership – C-Level Communication, Executive Reporting, Team Mentorship, Vendor Management



Project & Program Management – Project Roadmaps, Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy, Agile Project Development, MVP & Feature Prioritization, User Research, Competitive Analysis, Business Model Innovation, Market Research, Project Life Cycle Management.



Agile & IT Project Management – Agile Methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), Backlog Management, Sprint Planning, User Story Mapping, Jira, Confluence, Stakeholder Collaboration, User Acceptance Criteria, User Stories, Strategic Program Management, Requirements Gathering.

TECHNICAL SKILLS



Project & Agile Tools – JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, Microsoft Office 365 (Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Planner), ChatGPT



Data & Analytics – SQL (MySQL, SQL Server), Advance MS Excel, Excel automation using VBA

CERTIFICATIONS

DATA SCIENCE & ANALYTICS CERTIFICATION PROGRAM ( IVY Professional School)
